newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel slips with gas oil in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel slips with gas oil in slow trade.

text.p: European jet fuel prices lost some of Friday's gains on the back of weaker IPE gas oil futures which lost more than $3 a tonne at one point.
Jet fuel premiums were largely unchanged, although the market was so quiet as to be almost notional, said some dealers.
March IPE gas oil closed down $2.00 at $167.00 a tonne.
Traders said jet barge premiums were unchanged at around March IPE +$20-21 fob, but the market was very quiet.
"It's absolutely dead. No one wants to buy, a lot of business was done at the beginning of the year," said one dealer.
"People are talking jet, but not trading," said another.
Cargoes on a cif basis were heard around $2 higher than barges.
